item.title: Magellan Diagnostics, Inc.: LeadCare II Blood Lead Test Kit. Model/Catalog Number: 70-6762. Recall
item.product: LeadCare II Blood Lead Test Kit. Model/Catalog Number: 70-6762.
item.summary: In kit sub-lot 2530M-01 the date of expiration printed on the outer labeling may indicate the wrong expiration date of July 22, 2026 while the correct expiration date is July 13, 2026. If used the system will display an error message and prevent the operator from running the test. Resulting in delayed results. Product details: LeadCare II Blood Lead Test Kit. Model/Catalog Number: 70-6762.
item.affectedPeople: US Nationwide distribution in the states of CA, IN, PA, TX, NE, IL, MA, MO, KY.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
